title: Veinbound — ROLE VIEW; full state is DEBUG
rules: ROLE VIEW is the default. DEBUG FULL STATE explicitly reveals buried geodes and all private ledgers and is never a policy observation.
Two surveyor/excavator teams move on the real map, survey underground counts, excavate, carry and compete for eight finite geodes.
Buried locations/colours are invisible in every role view. Static terrain is public; current depth and other dynamic contents need the actual local view mask.
A scan ring means a real scan occurred. Actual historical counts appear only in the holder's private records or after a legitimate adjacent exchange.
Digging changes real depth; crystals appear only on actual exposure. Pickups, drops, forced drops and carriers use real object identity and positions.

Apply all entity and event component masks before role-frame serialization. A bank event publishes its valid bank endpoints and points to all roles. Match either endpoint to public bank_xy[b] and read bank_team[b]: (1,5) is team 0; (11,5) is team 1. Hidden depositor and geode identities remain redacted.
Shoves resolve after movement; a brace, protected base, invalid destination or simultaneous conflict can prevent them. Never fabricate a force-drop.
Bank preferred colour for two points, other colour for one. Compare complete simultaneous scores; natural outcomes precede H240 unresolved truncation.
Show the spatial board and actual mechanism events. Private numerical cards and public scores supplement gameplay.
Use only committed event identities; an absorbing state freezes time and must not repeat animations.

Pre-execution clarification: the original order applies facing before shoves. Committed turns are not rolled back; shoves cancel only still-pending operations. Use this fixed public order, not an outcome-selected rule.

world.presentation_rule: Public static terrain and bank anchors/teams/scores remain available outside current local visibility. Role views must filter dynamic entities, attributes and each event component before serialization; bank events publish their valid bank endpoints/value without granting hidden actor/geode identity. The debug view is separately labelled.

events.meaning: Committed transition event codes, gated by event_active; payloads describe actual accepted changes, with documented force/rejected-attempt exceptions.

kinds.name: step
kinds.from_to: old to accepted new world cell

kinds.name: dig
kinds.from_to: agent cell to addressed front soil cell
kinds.value: role work units actually applied before depth capping, 1 or 2
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.6 interval; dust at observed target, persistent crater from actual depth

kinds.name: reveal
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.6 interval; sparkle only on a real newly exposed and visible object

kinds.name: drop
kinds.from_to: carrier cell to valid front cell

kinds.name: bank
kinds.from_to: Same own-bank cell; every valid in-bounds endpoint is public to all roles. Match the endpoint to public bank_xy[b].
kinds.value: 1 or 2 actual banked points, public to all roles; team is public bank_team[b] at the uniquely matching bank_xy[b], independent of depositor identity.

kinds.name: exchange
kinds.actor: lowest-id initiating teammate solely for event identification
kinds.value: number of valid records in the resulting shared ledger, 0..6; disclose only to the participants
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.7 interval; observed link arc, no outsider record text

kinds.name: brace
kinds.visual_lifetime: one transition interval; no persistent protection is implied

kinds.name: shove
kinds.from_to: target's pre-shove cell to accepted forced cell
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.6 interval; draw only after event filtering

kinds.name: forced_drop
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.5 interval; the new surface object then persists by state

kinds.name: recharge
kinds.value: actual charge restored, 1..3; no event for zero

kinds.name: episode_end
kinds.visual_lifetime: one reveal; banner subsequently derives from done/winner/reason

events.replay_rule: Deduplicate tick/slot identities; interpolate actual stage endpoints only. Absorbing snapshots preserve events and must not replay them.
events.privacy_rule: Source/to/actor/object/value each has its own actual role mask. Active kind-7 bank events publish valid in-bounds bank endpoints and deposited value to every role. The existing public banks entity maps those coordinates to bank_team; actor and geode identities still require their unchanged local identity masks. No hidden geode, underground state or private scan ledger is disclosed.

observation_labels.meaning: Agent-centred patch. Channels: visible, wall, soil, own bank, other bank, paved, depth/2, own-team occupancy, rival occupancy, surface amber count/8, surface teal count/8, carried amber presence, carried teal presence, visible dig event, visible scan event, visible shove event. Out-of-bounds or non-visible channels are zero. Buried deposits never contribute. Event channels use the same conservative returned-state visibility projection as the renderer, so old visibility alone cannot disclose an offscreen new event.
Public one-hot terrain codes 0..4. This contains no depth, deposit or dynamic occupancy.
Per public agent id: visible, team, role, dx/4,dy/4, facing-vector x,y, charge/8, stun, cooldown/2. For hidden agents, only immutable team/role remain; all dynamic entries are zero and visible=0.

Per id: visible, amber flag, teal flag, dx/4,dy/4, carried flag, carrier_id/3 if carried else 0, public id/7. Populate only currently visible surface/carried geodes; all entries otherwise zero, including buried and banked objects.

Valid, origin x/12,y/10, radius/4, amber_count/4, teal_count/4, tick/240, original scanner id/3. Invalid rows zero. These are stored historical measurements, never recomputed from current underground state.
